changes: New realms: independent SQLite chat history, scene data, and room-scoped WebSocket participants.
Empty starter world, persistent 3D chat overlay, own messages right and other participants / AI left.
Draggable Add, Objects and Properties panes, Shift+A search and Enter to add, camera-safe transform controls.
Remote-user heads from FaceCap GLB, name labels, temporary chat balloons, opt-in webcam facial expression tracking.
WebXR controller input, hand models and teleportation remain available.
Fix Flask integration test Origin to match the watcher environment without weakening origin protection.
Fix Flask endpoint collision that prevented backend from starting (public_asset instead of static)
Add HTTP and Flask endpoint regression tests, keeping previous v0.2.1 frontend and features unchanged
Automatic full-stack deployment with Flask, SQLite and Nginx API/WebSocket proxy
Add compact messenger chat overlay, Meta model catalog and authenticated Responses API integration.
Add SQLite accounts with UUID, single active session, optional profile fields, portable recovery and media uploads.
Add admin-password gated server statistics, WebSocket room notifications and chat history.
Add Shift+A Three.js scene editor with transform gizmos, object inspector, colours, procedural texture choices and scene storage.
Add opt-in microphone, video, webcam profile photo, robot-view screenshot and FFmpeg intro GIF conversion.
Keep WebXR controllers, hands, teleportation and existing Mixamo animations.
Select exact Mixamo Idle clip; exclude Falling Idle regardless of animation order.
Add visible Enter VR control, tracked hands/controller models, XR action menu, and floor teleportation.
Disable WebSocket retries by default until backend enabled; optional multiplayer with ?live=1.
Add XR teleport and animation matching unit tests.
Fix missing Three.js BufferGeometryUtils module that prevented the scene loading.
Bundle all transitive Three.js addon dependencies instead of just three selected files.
Add automatic static ES module import-graph checks to catch missing browser modules.
Strengthen deployment verification to check module URLs before marking a release live.
Create SOLVI.help open-world Three.js and WebXR foundation.
Add rigged animated character with Idle, Walking, Running and Waving actions.
Add autonomous roaming, floor navigation, cubes and movement controls.
Add versioned deployment watcher, dev-log overlay and server verification.
Scaffold Flask WebSockets, shared presence and opt-in WebRTC media.
